content.title: Kristen Wiig: 'I turned down Bridesmaids 2' - IMDb
content.text: Kristen Wiig: 'I turned down Bridesmaids 2'Kristen Wiig has revealed that she turned down a major offer to star in Bridesmaids 2.There has been much speculation about a Bridesmaids sequel since the film made $288 million (£189 million) at the box office, with Melissa McCarthy and Maya Rudolph both expressing interest in returning.Wiig has now revealed to Harper's Bazaar that she and writing partner Annie Mumolo were in fact offered a sequel, but chose not to pursue the project."It wasn't a hard decision," Wiig explained to the publication.She went on to explain: "We knew during the first one, this was it. We would have made a lot of money if there was a second one, but that's not my goal in my creative life."Wiig went on to admit that it's odd for her to be playing romantic leads in movies, given that she played such bizarre characters on Saturday Night Live for many years.See full article at Digital Spy6/28/2013Digital SpySimilar NewsSaturday Night LiveDana Carvey Recalls Roots Of His Lorne Michaels Impression3/26/2026by Glenn GarnerDeadline Film + TVDana Carvey picks his favorite Saturday Night Live sketch of all time3/26/2026by Matt MooreLast Night OnFrom F-bombs to Season 2 hopes: 6 burning questions for ‘SNL UK’3/26/2026by Marcus James DixonGold DerbyKristen WiigMasters Of The Universe Character Art Teases A Surprising Change To Skeletor - Possible Spoilers3/26/2026ComicBookMovie.comEx-snl great has a problem with recent trend on the show: 'It doesn’t work'3/25/2026by Matt MooreLast Night On10 Best Sci-Fi Movies of 21st Century to Watch If You Loved Project Hail Mary3/24/2026by Anuraag ChatterjeeFandomWireMelissa McCarthy (I)Bridesmaids is Making its Big Debut on 4K Blu-ray this May from Universal3/25/2026by Bryony ClohessyMighty ChromaWhy ‘The Comeback’ Season 3 could make a comeback at the Emmys3/23/2026by Denton DavidsonGold Derby‘SNL’ Launches Digital Series ‘The Rundown’ for Stars to Break Down Its Greatest Hits | Video3/18/2026by Tess PattonThe WrapIMDb.com, Inc. takes no responsibility for the content or accuracy of the above news articles, Tweets, or blog posts.
